```sql
SELECT u.DisplayName, u.Location
FROM main.posts p
JOIN main.posts q ON p.AcceptedAnswerId = q.Id
JOIN main.users u ON q.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.PostTypeId = 1
  AND q.PostTypeId = 2
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', q.CreaionDate) = '2013-06-01'
  AND q.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName, u.Location
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10
```
